name: Mesmer
long_description:
Mesmer builds software factories for engineering teams. Keeping a team at the state of the art with agents has become a full-time job, and the target keeps moving. We do that job for our customers: we're always finding the biggest bottleneck in how their team ships and fixing it in their factory.

We're repeat founders and CTOs in Berlin, backed by YC, GFC and 468 Capital.
one_liner: We build software factories for engineering teams
